description: This file contains functions for upgrading firmware on Sony devices using shell commands, including partition updates, flashing kernel and root filesystem, and filesystem formatting.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates the BOOTCONFIG partition at a specific offset with a new index, and similarly updates BOOTCONFIG1 if it exists. Uses dd and hexdump for reading and writing partition data.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by flashing kernel and root filesystem from a specified tar file, updates boot configuration, formats rootfs_data, saves configuration backup if present, and reboots the device.
